classification.difficultyReason: Extract the marked right triangle from each surrounding figure and choose addition or subtraction. The prism additionally requires transferring the corresponding 65 m edge to the front triangular face.

spec.description: Cone with solid silhouette and front base arc, dashed rear base arc, dashed perpendicular height and radius.
spec.mathematics: The height is 60 cm, slant height is 65 cm and unknown base radius is s. Height and radius meet at a right angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The given dimensions and s remain visible; the supplied 25 cm answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The height and radius form a right-angled triangle with the slant height.
$$\begin{align*}s&=\sqrt{65^2-60^2}\\s&=\sqrt{625}\\s&=25\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Kite with perpendicular diagonals, matching single ticks on top and right sides and matching double ticks on left and bottom sides.
spec.mathematics: The bottom triangle has perpendicular legs 54 cm and 72 cm and hypotenuse y. The two equal-side pairs remain distinct.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens and equality marks remain visible; the supplied 90 cm answer is excluded.

spec.description: Sphere outline with an equatorial ellipse, smaller upper circular section and an interior right triangle.
spec.mathematics: The upper-section radius is 21 cm, the sphere radius is 35 cm and the perpendicular distance between their centres is a. The 21 cm label belongs to the horizontal radius, not the full diameter.
spec.answerVisibility: The section radius, sphere radius and a remain visible; the supplied 28 cm answer is excluded.

spec.description: Triangular prism extending upwards and right, with dashed hidden edges and a dashed front-face altitude. A bracket measures only the base segment from the altitude foot to the right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The front altitude y is perpendicular to the 25 m base segment. The corresponding rear sloping edge is 65 m, giving the front right triangle a 65 m hypotenuse.
spec.answerVisibility: The altitude, half-base bracket and rear sloping-edge measurement remain visible; the supplied 60 m answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The corresponding sloping edge of the front triangle is $65\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}y&=\sqrt{65^2-25^2}\\y&=\sqrt{3600}\\y&=60\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
